  by lift n to ℕ using h1.le; simp only [Int.toNat_natCast]; rw [Nat.totient_eq_card_coprime]; have e : {r ∈ (Set.Icc (0 : ℤ) ((n : ℤ) - 1) : Set ℤ) | (Int.gcd r (n : ℤ) : ℤ) = 1} = (((Finset.range n).filter n.Coprime).map ⟨fun i : ℕ => (i : ℤ), Nat.cast_injective⟩ : Finset ℤ) := (by ext r; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Icc, Finset.coe_map, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]; constructor; (rintro ⟨⟨h0, hr⟩, hg⟩; refine ⟨r.toNat, ⟨(by omega), ?_⟩, (by omega)⟩; rw [Nat.coprime_comm, Nat.Coprime, ← Int.gcd_natCast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0]; exact_mod_cast hg); (rintro ⟨i, ⟨hi, hc⟩, rfl⟩; refine ⟨⟨(by omega), (by omega)⟩, ?_⟩; rw [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast, Nat.Coprime.gcd_eq_one (Nat.coprime_comm.mp hc)]; rfl)); rw [e, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Finset.card_map]

theorem mun_coprime_product (x : ℤ) (y : ℤ) (n : ℤ) (h3 : 0 < n) (h4 : (Int.gcd x n : ℤ) = 1) (h5 : (Int.gcd y n : ℤ) = 1) :

theorem mun_prime_power_not_less (p : ℤ) (h1 : 0 < p) (h2 : Nat.Prime p.toNat) (a : ℤ) (h3 : 0 ≤ a) (a' : ℤ) (h4 : 0 ≤ a') (m : ℤ) (m' : ℤ) (h7 : (Int.gcd m p : ℤ) = 1) (h8 : p ^ a.toNat * m = p ^ a'.toNat * m') :
    ¬ a < a' :=
  by lift p to ℕ using h1.le; lift a to ℕ using h3; lift a' to ℕ using h4; simp only [Int.toNat_natCast] at h2 h8; intro hlt; have hp : Prime (p : ℤ) := Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 h2; have hle : a + 1 ≤ a' := (by omega); have hdvd : (p : ℤ) ^ (a + 1) ∣ (p : ℤ) ^ a * m := (h8 ▸ Dvd.dvd.mul_right (pow_dvd_pow _ hle) _); rw [pow_succ] at hdvd; have hpm : (p : ℤ) ∣ m := (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (pow_ne_zero a hp.ne_zero)).1 hdvd; have hc : IsCoprime m (p : ℤ) := Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.2 (by exact_mod_cast h7); exact hp.not_unit (hc.isUnit_of_dvd' hpm (dvd_refl _))

theorem mun_prime_power_unique (p : ℤ) (h1 : 0 < p) (h2 : Nat.Prime p.toNat) (a : ℤ) (h3 : 0 ≤ a) (a' : ℤ) (h4 : 0 ≤ a') (m : ℤ) (m' : ℤ) (h7 : (Int.gcd m p : ℤ) = 1) (h8 : (Int.gcd m' p : ℤ) = 1) (h9 : p ^ a.toNat * m = p ^ a'.toNat * m') :

  by rcases lt_trichotomy a a' with h | h | h; exacts [absurd h (mun_prime_power_not_less p h1 h2 a h3 a' h4 m m' h7 h9), h, absurd h (mun_prime_power_not_less p h1 h2 a' h4 a h3 m' m h8 h9.symm)]

theorem thm_prime_powers_unique_1 (a : ℤ) (h1 : 0 ≤ a) (b : ℤ) (h2 : 0 ≤ b) (c : ℤ) (h3 : 0 ≤ c) (a' : ℤ) (h4 : 0 ≤ a') (b' : ℤ) (h5 : 0 ≤ b') (c' : ℤ) (h6 : 0 ≤ c') (h7 : (2 ^ a.toNat * 3 ^ b.toNat * 5 ^ c.toNat : ℤ) = 2 ^ a'.toNat * 3 ^ b'.toNat * 5 ^ c'.toNat) :

theorem thm_prime_powers_unique_3 (a : ℤ) (h1 : 0 ≤ a) (b : ℤ) (h2 : 0 ≤ b) (c : ℤ) (h3 : 0 ≤ c) (a' : ℤ) (h4 : 0 ≤ a') (b' : ℤ) (h5 : 0 ≤ b') (c' : ℤ) (h6 : 0 ≤ c') (h7 : (2 ^ a.toNat * 3 ^ b.toNat * 5 ^ c.toNat : ℤ) = 2 ^ a'.toNat * 3 ^ b'.toNat * 5 ^ c'.toNat) :

theorem thm_product_coprime (X : Set ℤ) (h1 : X ⊆ (Set.univ : Set ℤ)) (h2 : X.Finite) (n : ℤ) (h3 : 0 < n) (h4 : ∀ y ∈ X, (Int.gcd y n : ℤ) = 1) :
    (Int.gcd (∏ᶠ x ∈ X, (x : ℤ)) n : ℤ) = 1 :=
  by rw [finprod_mem_eq_finite_toFinset_prod _ h2]; have h := IsCoprime.prod_left (t := h2.toFinset) (s := fun i : ℤ => i) (fun i hi => Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.2 (by exact_mod_cast h4 i (h2.mem_toFinset.1 hi)) : ∀ i ∈ h2.toFinset, IsCoprime i (n : ℤ)); exact_mod_cast Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.1 h

    (∏ᶠ x ∈ X, (t x : ℤ)) ≡ (∏ᶠ x ∈ X, (u x : ℤ)) [ZMOD n] :=
  by rw [finprod_mem_eq_finite_toFinset_prod _ h1, finprod_mem_eq_finite_toFinset_prod _ h1]; exact Int.ModEq.prod fun x hx => h3 x ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset h1).mp hx)

    (∏ᶠ x ∈ X, (x * c : ℤ)) ≡ (∏ᶠ x ∈ X, (f x : ℤ)) [ZMOD n] :=
